ac3 INVALIDATION PROOF MECHANISM (the spawn's central ask, pinned non-weasellably): each mutation test mounts a real QueryClientProvider with (a) the live resource observer query (e.g. use_expenses list) and (b) a DUMMY mounted observer keyed exactly ['dashboard','probe'] whose queryFn calls a counted MSW handler. The proof is HANDLER CALL COUNTS observed before/after the mutation (invalidation => refetch => count increment) — never reading useMutation({onSuccess}) code. Negative controls are pinned as their own frozen nodes: expense mutations never call categories/budgets handlers, budget mutations never call expenses/categories handlers, category mutations never call expenses/budgets handlers AND category mutations must NOT refetch the dashboard observer (REQ-FE-051: category mutations invalidate ['categories'] only — the asymmetry is a testable node, not a comment). The dummy-observer trick is how ['dashboard'] is proven without any phase_4 query existing, satisfying the issue's Constraint.
